⑧ 保存 PNG（保留原画幅）
② 蒙版诊断
人物修改提示词
widgets_values:
Professional high-end beauty retouching of this portrait — the finish seen in
studio sample galleries. Keep the same person, the same makeup design and the
same photograph; refine only what is already visible. Keep pose, expression,
gaze, hairstyle, clothing, jewelry, background and crop unchanged. Add nothing,
remove nothing.

FACE AND NECK — reshape the contour, not the structure. Pull the jawline inward
so ear-to-chin becomes one smooth arc with no corner at the jaw angle; the
rounder or fuller the original face, the more it narrows, while cheekbone
position, face length and facial proportion stay those of the source. Narrow the
mid-face slightly so cheekbones, eyes and mouth align in a cleaner vertical
column. Reduce fullness in the lower cheeks and under the chin. The chin loses
width, not length. Correct visible asymmetry only until it balances — a size
difference between the eyes, a tilted mouth corner, a lopsided jawline — never
into a symmetrical mask.

FIGURE — edit the existing silhouette, do not regenerate the body. Move the
outlines inward; do not repaint, regenerate or re-render any part of the body.
Every pore, fine hair, highlight and shadow on the skin stays exactly where it
is; only the edges move inward. Slim the body to the same degree as the face,
judged against the face:
- Neck: lengthen it by about fifteen percent and slim it until the neck is
  clearly narrower than the face. The distance from the jaw to the collarbone
  should be close to the height of the face.
- Shoulders: drop and flatten the trapezius so the neck-to-shoulder line is
  almost horizontal instead of sloping, and narrow the shoulder width so the
  shoulder line is no wider than two face widths.
- Torso and back: reduce the thickness of the back and of the side profile.
- Collarbone: bring it out with a soft hollow beneath it.

ARMS — edit the silhouette only, never repaint the arm. Move the existing outline
inward. The pores, fine hairs, skin tone, bracelet, watch and every highlight on
the arm must stay exactly where they are; only the outer and the inner edges
shift inward. Regenerating the arm is wrong, because a regenerated arm comes back
fuller than the original.
- Slim the upper arm, the elbow region, the forearm and the wrist as one
  continuous taper, so the wrist is clearly the narrowest point of the arm.
- The finished arm must be narrower than the source at every point along its
  length — never equal, never wider. Brightened skin looks larger than it is, so
  take off more than the shape alone would need, to offset that.
- Open a visible gap of light between the arm and the torso wherever they are
  close. A slim arm separates from the body instead of merging into it.
- Keep the elbow small and soft, keep the arm length unchanged, and keep the
  hand where it is. When a hand rests against the face or the chin, slim the arm
  underneath without moving the hand or changing where it touches the skin.

HANDS — only if visible, and they must not grow. Slim the palm and the base of
the fingers, and taper each finger from base to tip so the hand reads lean; the
finished hand must never be larger than in the source. Keep the fingertip shape,
the nail shape, length and polish colour exactly as they are. Soften the knuckles
without erasing them, and keep a faint suggestion of tendons on the back of the
hand. Do not lengthen the fingers, do not thin them into sticks, do not touch
rings or bracelets, do not move the wrist.

SCULPT — the face must read three-dimensional, not flatly lit. Place small,
bright, crisp specular highlights on both cheekbone tops, the nose bridge, the
forehead centre, the chin, the cupid's bow and the nose tip. Balance them with
soft shadows under the cheekbones, along both sides of the nose, under the jaw
and along the temples. The step between highlight and shadow must be strong
enough to read as a shaped form, with soft transitions but never washed into a
flat even surface.

SKIN — clearly whiter, fairer, softer, and zoned. Lift exposure on all skin by
one to one and a half stops and shift the temperature from warm yellow to clean
neutral-cool ivory, removing the yellow and orange cast entirely; the skin must
read obviously whiter and tenderer at a glance, sitting just below the
overexposure point. Clear blemishes, spots, redness, under-eye shadows,
nasolabial lines and visible pores, and smooth into a fine tender satin finish
with a light dewy sheen, keeping faint texture and one quarter of the original
shadow depth. Keep a faint rosy-pink bloom on the cheeks, nose tip and ears —
bright but alive, never one flat dead white. Keep highlights translucent with
colour inside them. Distinguish shine from oil: keep the glow on the cheekbones
and clear the greasy glare from the T-zone, nose tip and forehead. Match neck,
shoulders, arms and hands in brightness, temperature and softness.

HAIR — this decides whether the result looks professionally retouched. Lift the
hair at the roots so the crown gains real, visible height, and add body at the
sides so the hair frames the face instead of lying flat against the skull. A
higher crown makes the face read smaller, so the lift must be obvious. Restore
shine, separate strands into visible layers, brighten the already-lit sections,
and clean the flyaways along the silhouette. Keep the parting, length, curl
pattern and hair ornaments.

FEATURES — delicate and precise. Eyes: open the eye area about five percent,
keeping the original spacing, tilt and gaze; make both eyes match in size, in
iris size and in pupil size, and place the catchlights in the same position on
both eyes. Add a soft illuminated lower eyelid, a faint rosy wash under the lower
lashes, denser separated upper and lower lashes, a deeper lash line, and a calm
lively gaze that is never glassy or vacant. Brows: sharpen the outline, define
individual hairs, keep the original arch and thickness. Nose: narrow the bridge
and alae and raise the bridge line so it reads taller and narrower. Lips: soft
rose-pink, a fuller lower lip, a defined cupid's bow, a moist highlight on the
centre of the lower lip, visible lip texture; level a crooked mouth line until
the lips sit even. Teeth, only if already visible: whiten to an even natural
shade and clean the gum line, keeping the original shape and spacing.

MAKEUP — refine what is there, never apply a new look. Keep the original
placement, size and colour family of eyeshadow, liner, blush, highlighter,
contour and lipstick. The finished makeup must read clearly defined, never washed
out: sharpen the liner edge, separate the lashes, deepen the crease slightly,
restore the blush gradient, clarify the lip line. A bare-looking face is wrong.
Do not move or resize the blush, do not change the eyeshadow colour, do not
flatten the lips into plastic. Painted marks, beauty moles, gems, glitter and
face paint are not blemishes — keep them exactly.

WARDROBE: flatten fabric creases and the shoulder seams, tidy the neckline, and
remove any strap or underwear line showing through. The fabric, chokers, straps
and necklaces re-fit the new outline without stretching, warping, loosening or
shifting its pattern. Keep the garment design, colour and pattern intact.

LIGHT AND BACKGROUND: keep the scene's original lighting on the background and
surroundings — only the face and body get brighter, cooler and more shaped. The
background keeps its original brightness, contrast, saturation and depth of
field, and keeps the horizon, sea line, railings and door frames level and
straight. Nothing outside the subject is retouched.

DETAIL: keep hair strands, lashes, jewelry, lace, beading and pattern edges
crisp — never smeared by smoothing. No plastic sheen, no masking edges, no
halos, no colour noise in the shadows. Keep clothing colour and saturation.

The result is wrong if any visible arm is the same width as the source or wider,
if the arm was visibly repainted or re-rendered, if the arm does not taper from
elbow to wrist, if the arm still merges into the body with no gap of light, if
any hand became larger than in the source, if the head looks small while the neck
or shoulders still look heavy, if the neck is not narrower than the face, if the
shoulders still slope, if the face reads flat with no highlight or shadow
modelling, if the crown gained no height, if the skin still looks as dark or
yellow as the source, if any background line is bent, or if the face no longer
looks like the same person.

properties.标题文本:
1. 先上传原图，右键加载图像→遮罩编辑器，只涂人物并保存。
2. 白色=人物；背景会自动反转，不需再画一次。
3. 编辑需求清空/只留空格=跳过该区域。
4. AI优化为独立开关；未验证本地模型兼容前保持关闭。
5. 本版按原像素裁剪（不再压成正方形），保持原图比例，恢复到原坐标和原画幅。
6. 最终合成严格按原蒙版限域，人物外轮廓不扩大；人物内部姿态仍依赖模型。
7. 背景降噪0.6、人像0.35为默认；想要更强改0.7/0.45，更保守改0.5/0.25。降噪低于0.4基本看不出变化。
8. 未涂蒙版会中文报错，而不是自动重绘全图。
9. 超大图（长边超2000）建议先缩小，原像素采样会更慢。
